snippet.title: Kennel Chaos - First Look at Demo Trailer #2
snippet.description:
🐶 Kennel Chaos — Steam Next Fest Gameplay Trailer!

You and your friends run a dog daycare.

It goes badly.

Feed the dogs. Wash them. Walk them. Clean up their messes. Build and upgrade your daycare. And whatever you do… DON’T LEAVE THE GATE OPEN.

Kennel Chaos is a chaotic 1–8 player co-op dog daycare simulator where every dog has a personality — and small problems have a habit of turning into complete disasters.

🎮 PLAY THE FREE DEMO DURING STEAM NEXT FEST!

🐕 21 dog breeds with unique traits
👥 1–8 player online co-op
🛁 Feed, wash, groom, walk & care for your dogs
💩 Clean up before the mess gets MUCH worse
🔨 Build and decorate your own daycare
💰 Grow your business and take on more dogs
🚪 Try not to lose all of them

Wishlist Kennel Chaos on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5136890/Kennel_Chaos/

Coming to Steam 2027.

Developed by Watashi Games

#KennelChaos #SteamNextFest #IndieGames #CoopGames #SimulationGames #DogGames #SteamGames
